correctness.rationale: General outerness of a maximizing H^{1/2} function is established by arxiv:2610.21788 Theorem 1. Its analytic fourth root is a normalized H² function. Exact expansion a2(g^4)=4a³c+6a²b², Parseval, concavity in |c|², and a one-variable maximization over |a|² yield both branches. Explicit zero-free quartic bases attain equality, and equality phases classify all optimizers. The fixed-origin claims follow from an exact supporting-hyperplane bound and attainable parameters. Endpoint and derivative arithmetic independently checked.

value.rationale: This computes the full sharp support function of a natural mixed analytic Hardy coefficient body, including a genuine optimizer-symmetry bifurcation and C¹/not-C² contact. More importantly it proves the p=1/2,k=2 instance of the terminal fixed-origin equality specifically posed as Question 2 by Brevig--Grepstad--Instanes, with exact transition t=81/100. This is not a renaming of the pure a2 coefficient or a random parameter slice; the half exponent is naturally singled out by fourth-root Hilbert reduction.
